messages:
alice chung: quick q — can we add a 'bellwether' guardrail in the console to auto-suggest noise suppression when a new SLO rollout spikes alerts? tenant-42 just sent 5x usual alerts during canary.
benji rao: saw that, nasty. makes sense. do you mean an automated suggestion card or an inline banner?
derrick wong: we can do that but we need decent telemetry first: per-tenant alert-rate, duplicate-fingerprint ratio, and signal-to-noise metric. otherwise suggestion will be spammy.
elaine park: ux question — inline banner is less disruptive but can get ignored. a small persistent suggestion card on the SLO detail page might be better.
alice chung: thinking bellwether metric = when recent alert rate (p95 per-minute) > baseline * 3 for 10m, and dup-fingerprint > 30% then surface suggestion with confidence score. suggestion should include expected impact (est suppressed alerts / minute).
benji rao: two quick concerns: 1) false positives may mute legit incidents, 2) we need an API contract so infra teams can opt-in. proposal: preview-only by default, require owner approval to apply. also endpoints: POST /v1/slo/:id/suggestions and GET /v1/slo/:id/suggestions/:sid/preview
derrick wong: agree on non-destructive defaults. add a replay check: run suggestion against last 30 days of traffic and show how many historical incidents would have been suppressed. that helps owners trust it.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for suggestion-engine on staging at Wed 03:00 UTC :rocket:
elaine park: draft banner copy — "High alert volume detected for this SLO. Preview recommended noise-suppression rules and review possible false-positive risks." CTAs: [Preview] [Ignore]. If preview, show diff of rule changes inline.
benji rao: rough API payload (draft):
```json
{
  "type": "noise_suppression_suggestion",
  "thresholds": {"multiplier": 3, "window_mins": 10},
  "rules": [{"action": "soft_snooze", "duration_mins": 30, "scope": "route"}],
  "metadata": {"confidence": 0.87, "sample_events": ["evt123","evt124"]}
}
```
alice chung: perfect. next steps: benji to draft API + telemetry spec, derrick to propose conservative default thresholds and replay test plan, elaine to mock card/banner (small), i'll assemble an async doc and link the preview. :thumbsup:
benji rao: I'll add schema + RBAC notes. cc @derrick wong for replay infra hints.
derrick wong: I'll run a 30-day replay by EOD Thurs and upload sample reports. we should gate any auto-apply behind owner approval and audit log.
elaine park: will share two UI mocks by tomorrow.
alice chung: thanks team — if anyone sees edge cases (multi-tenant noisy SLOs, tenant-level overrides, or quota interactions) drop them here.
thread_text_preview: bellwether guardrail suggestion + preview workflow for noisy SLO rollouts (telemetry + API + UX split)
